assets.title: Circuit Reroute
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-screen background painting for Brick Blaster: Nexus Breakers, a polished mobile 2D neon paddle-and-ball adventure. Premium illustrated science-fiction environment, layered atmosphere, sleek cyan/violet architecture and restrained warm accents. Composition: full-bleed landscape 1536x864, central 65 percent quiet and low contrast for bright moving gameplay, essential environment also readable in a central portrait crop. Buildings and mechanical detail mainly along the edges and distant horizon. No text, letters, logos, watermark, borders, UI, paddles, balls, floating bricks, enemies or foreground targets. Scene: a grand power-conduit hall overlooking a futuristic city, cyan energy channels running up the side walls, violet industrial columns, warm amber electrical glow at the edges. The broad open central hall is dark indigo with soft volumetric haze, not a busy tunnel. Gorgeous controlled lighting and distant city depth.
